signin.title: Dukaankaaga, si toos ah
signin.subtitle: Iib kasta marka uu dhaco, macaamiishaada joogtada ah, iyo waxa maanta u baahan in la qabto.
signin.step1: Ka fur Zapp Pay Merchant taleefankaaga
signin.step3: Taabo “Ka gal kombiyuutar” oo sawir koodhkan
signin.readOnly: Boggani wuxuu muujiyaa tirooyinka oo keliya. Lacag bixinta, lacag-bixinta iyo celinta waxay ku jiraan taleefankaaga, PIN-kaaga gadaashiisa.
signin.declined: Taleefanka ayaa lagu diiday. Waa kan kood cusub.
signin.error: Lama gaari karo Zapp. Hubi isku xirka oo mar kale isku day.
signin.ended: Waa lagaa saaray. Mar kale sawir koodhka si aad u sii wadato.
attention.title: Waxa u baahan feejignaantaada
attention.allClear: Wax walba waa hagaagsan yihiin. Hadda waxba kuu baahan ma jiraan.
insight.quiet_till.title: Khasnaddaadu way aamusnayd ilaa {{time}}
insight.quiet_till.body: {{weekday}} caadi ah waxaa labadan saacadood ku dhaca qiyaastii {{expected}} iib. Hubi in macaamiishu lacag bixin karaan.
insight.quiet_till.step1: Stiikarka QR-ka ee miiska ma muuqdaa, mana dhaawacan yahay?
insight.quiet_till.step2: Shaashadda miisku ma shidan tahay, ma muujinaysaa QR-ka dukaankaaga?
insight.quiet_till.step3: Weydii qasnajiga in macaamiisha lagu leeyahay lacag caddaan ah bixiya.
insight.display_offline.title: Shaashadda miiska “{{name}}” way go'an tahay
insight.display_offline.body: Macaamiisha miiska joogta ma arki karaan QR-kaaga. Markii ugu dambeysay {{time}}.
insight.display_offline.bodyNever: Macaamiisha miiska joogta ma arki karaan QR-kaaga.
insight.display_offline.step1: Hubi in tablet-ku shidan yahay, dallacayo, oo Wi-Fi ku xiran yahay.
insight.display_offline.step2: Mar kale ku fur bogga shaashadda miiska ee Zapp Pay.
insight.display_offline.step3: Weli ma xirna? Zapp Pay Merchant, Dejinta → Shaashadda miiska: ka saar oo dib u xir.
